abstract: Higher education is a cornerstone of national development, promoting innovation, equipping individuals with future-ready skills, and addressing global challenges such as equitable access to quality education. In the Philippines, State Universities and Colleges (SUCs) aim to democratize higher education, but systemic barriers persist, limiting access for marginalized groups. This study investigates the determinants of successful admission to the Bachelor of Science in Information Systems (BSIS) program at three SUC campuses. Using a quantitative research design, logistic regression analysis was applied to a dataset comprising socio-demographic, academic, and family-related variables from 499 applicants during the academic year 2024–2025. The analysis identified key predictors of admission, such as demographics, high school strands, family dynamics, and access to personal computers. Results indicate that being an Indigenous applicant significantly increases the likelihood of admission, underscoring the effectiveness of affirmative action policies. Additionally, family circumstances positively influence admission outcomes. Conversely, applicants from public high schools and female students exhibit lower odds of admission, highlighting potential inequities in the selection process. The study also reveals that STEM strand graduates are less likely to be admitted than those from TVL strands, suggesting a misalignment between high school curricula and BSIS program requirements. While the logistic regression model achieved an accuracy of 72%, it demonstrated challenges in correctly identifying non-admitted applicants.

articleTitle: The Impact of Social Media on Dietary Supplement Consumption in Bahrain
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on IT Innovation and Knowledge Discovery (ITIKD)
abstract: The popularity of social media (SM) platforms for health and nutrition information has risen, with influencers promoting various products, including dietary supplements (DS). This study analyzes participants' knowledge and attitudes towards DS, as well as the impact of SM on DS consumption in Bahrain. Data from 240 participants, collected through a self-administered electronic questionnaire, revealed a high prevalence of DS use at 72.5%. Most purchases were based on recommendations from doctors (53.8%), followed by social media influencers (36.6%). Of the users, 42.9% had good knowledge about DS, and 89.6% reported no side effects. The main reasons for DS use included general well-being (38.8%) and preventing nutritional deficiencies (15.7%). Vitamin D (44.6%), vitamin C (35.0%), and iron (30.8%) were the most consumed supplements. Instagram (46.3%) was the leading platform for DS-related content, yet 86.3% of users showed no interest in DS promoted by influencers, doubting its health benefits (71.3%). Furthermore, 81% found SM messages about DS unconvincing, with no significant link between SM use and DS consumption (p=0.397). Notably, Bahrainis and single participants reported higher DS use compared to other demographics. While SM can be a useful tool for nutrition information, misinformation from influencers may negatively affect DS consumption. This study highlights the need for public educational programs about proper DS use and suggests future research into the negative effects of social media on DS consumption.

articleTitle: Promoting Constructive Online Debates Through Toxic Comment Classifier
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on IT Innovation and Knowledge Discovery (ITIKD)
abstract: The widespread use of online platforms for communication has given rise to the issue of toxic comments, which can have detrimental effects on individuals and communities. In this research, we present a toxic comment classifier that aims to automatically identify and classify toxic comments with high accuracy. We leverage a dataset consisting of annotated toxic comments, employing a mix of machine learning methods and natural language processing techniques. Through comprehensive testing and evaluation, we show that our method is effective in correctly identifying harmful comments. Our classifier achieves F1-score exceeding 85% across different toxicity categories. The developed toxic comment classifier has the potential to contribute to the creation of safer and more inclusive online environments, enabling proactive moderation and targeted intervention. This study emphasises how crucial it is to use machine learning approaches to fight toxic behaviour and promote constructive online discussion.

articleTitle: A Blockchain-Driven Secure Management of Patient Health Records Using Federated Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on IT Innovation and Knowledge Discovery (ITIKD)
abstract: The healthcare industry is grappling with the challenges of ensuring data security, privacy, and interoperability of patient health records. Traditional centralized systems are vulnerable to data breaches and unauthorized access. Blockchain technology, with its decentralized and immutable nature, offers a promising solution to address these issues. This paper proposes a blockchain-based system for managing patient health records, aiming to enhance data security, privacy, and accessibility. The proposed system leverages smart contracts to automate the process of recording, updating, and sharing health records. By utilizing cryptographic techniques, the system ensures data integrity and prevents unauthorized modifications. Patients are empowered to control their health data, granting access to authorized healthcare providers while maintaining privacy. Additionally, the system facilitates seamless data sharing between different healthcare institutions, improving interoperability and enabling efficient patient care. Through rigorous analysis and experimentation, we evaluate the performance and security of the proposed system. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of blockchain in addressing the challenges of traditional health record management. This research contributes to the advancement of healthcare technology by providing a secure, transparent, and efficient solution for managing patient health information.

articleTitle: A Novel Dual-Crossed Deep Learning with an Adaptive Metaheuristic Approach and Improved AlexNet Based Covid-19 Variant Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on IT Innovation and Knowledge Discovery (ITIKD)
abstract: The genomic analysis of COVID-19 is essential for understanding its evolution, detecting mutations, and tracking its epidemiological spread. This study proposes a bioinformatics-driven framework integrating advanced preprocessing, feature extraction, and classification techniques. The preprocessing phase applies N-gram tokenization, Quality Filtering, and Min-Max Scaling to refine genomic sequences. For feature extraction, the framework integrates a Dual-Crossed Improved AlexNet with a K-Means Clustering-based Self-Adaptive Tuna Swarm Optimization (SA-TSO) algorithm to enhance feature learning and representation. The Improved AlexNet incorporates Batch Normalization (BN) for stable training and Global Average Pooling (GAP) to reduce overfitting and computational complexity. For classification, an Improved BiRNN is employed to provide precise mutation identification and viral strain categorization, model long-range connections and highlight important genomic patterns. This integrated approach enhances the ability to monitor COVID-19 mutations, track epidemiological patterns, and support public health interventions by providing deeper insights into viral evolution and transmission dynamics. The experimental findings show that the suggested method achieves the maximum precision with 70% on the learning rate (98.9) and high precision with 80% on the learning rate (99.1).

articleTitle: AI in Palliative Cancer Care: Legislative Strategies and Regulatory Frameworks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on IT Innovation and Knowledge Discovery (ITIKD)
abstract: Palliative care (PC) and hospice care emphasize the relief of the suffering of life-threatening serious conditions such as cancer, with a focus on the integration of palliative cancer care (PCC) into the health care systems to achieve universal health coverage and promote well-being. Integrating artificial intelligence (AI) into PCC requires a tailored policy framework to navigate challenges such as costs, data barriers, and workflow integration. Emerging AI technologies show promise in screening for psychological distress and enhancing care delivery, yet regulatory environments remain in their early stages of development. Legislative strategies must adapt to the rapidly evolving AI landscape, with a particular focus on addressing gaps in AI governance specific to palliative care. Transparency, privacy protection, and ethical considerations to ensure equitable access to medications and therapies are paramount in the regulatory framework for AI applications in healthcare. Moving forward, collaboration among stakeholders is essential to ensure ethical priorities are met, and further innovative research is needed to explore domain-specific details and complete disability policies for the optimal integration of AI in palliative care. This paper aims to increase the awareness of policymakers and the public about the size of the addressed problem, the suffering associated with cancer, the importance of PCC as a human right and responsibility, and its integration with cancer disease management strategies to provide more comprehensive cancer care.

Author Keywords: AI – Palliative Cancer care – Legislative Strategies – Human rights

articleTitle: AI Based Methods for Insider Threats Detection for Cloud Risk Mitigation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on IT Innovation and Knowledge Discovery (ITIKD)
abstract: The evolution of cloud computing and its increased adoption has revolutionized data storage and accessibility but has given way to security vulnerabilities, such as insider threats. These threats make use of their authorized access to compromise sensitive data and disrupt services, posing huge concerns about cloud security. Traditional perimeterbased methods struggle to address these threats, making Artificial Intelligence (AI) based solutions a favorable choice for offering security against insider threats. This article discusses the role of AI in insider threat mitigation in the cloud, pointing out its ability to analyze user behavior, detect anomalies, and respond to possible threats. An extensive study of existing AIbased methods is performed, which highlights their strengths and weaknesses. Furthermore, the use case of AI solutions for insider threat detection and mitigation in the cloud is also explored, showcasing their applicability in real-world scenarios. Finally, we point out the challenges linked with AI-powered solutions and offer future direction to enhance the AI-based detection and mitigation of insider threats.

articleTitle: Voice Cloning Detection Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on IT Innovation and Knowledge Discovery (ITIKD)
abstract: The rapid progress of artificial intelligence technologies has transformed how humans communicate with machines; voice recognition has been increasingly used as a unique “voice fingerprint” for authorization and task execution, motivating the development of technologies that use voice for identity verification. However, techniques have also emerged that attempt to falsify voices to impersonate others and invade privacy. Deepfake voice technology, which relies on creating data sets of human voices, uses deep learning and machine learning to analyze voice characteristics and build models that can replicate sounds with high accuracy. This research presents a deep learning-based model designed to detect forged or artificially synthesized voices. A dataset containing both genuine and synthetic human voices was used. Sound waves were transformed into frequency representations, then converted to digital matrices on which a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) was trained. During training, the model extracted recurring features in sounds and classified them as real or fake. The main objective of this study is to evaluate deep learning's ability to achieve reliable results for security and authentication applications. The model achieved an accuracy of over 90% after training on the dataset. To further validate its effectiveness, the proposed model was compared to others, such as K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), demonstrating its superior performance.

articleTitle: Accessible Edugaming: Fostering Inclusive Learning Through Interactive Points, Leaderboards, and Confidence-Building Features
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on IT Innovation and Knowledge Discovery (ITIKD)
abstract: This research introduces a novel educational paradigm through the development of a MERN-based (Mon-goDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js) interactive gamification platform specifically designed f or creating inclusive learning environments. The proposed system achieves a 42 % increase in learning engagement among disabled students through adaptive interfaces and accessibility features, compared to traditional educational technologies. By implementing a multi-tiered point system with customizable difficulty levels, the platform demon-strates a 37% improvement in knowledge retention and a 53% boost in continued learning motivation. The platform's intelligent leaderboard system, featuring dynamic normalization algorithms, ensures equitable competition with a fairness index of 0.89, regardless of user ability status. Extensive testing reveals a 91 % satisfaction rate among disabled users, compared to 67 % with conventional educational applications. Performance analysis shows a 47% reduction in learning curve steepness for students with various disabilities, while maintaining comprehension parity with non-disabled peers. This approach transforms conventional educational paradigms by combining technical innovation with inclusive design principles, creating measurable improvements in educational outcomes for all learners, particularly those with special needs.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Logic Control System for Smart Home Energy Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on IT Innovation and Knowledge Discovery (ITIKD)
abstract: This paper offers an extensive examination of Fuzzy Logic Control (FLC) systems in smart home energy management, with emphasis on their use in dynamic and uncertain settings. FLC offers a strong framework for modeling control systems where inputs are uncertain and partially controlled by the system. The study explores how FLCs facilitate smart homes to optimize energy consumption through balancing short-term consumption with long-term energy saving, especially in situations with time- varying energy demands and uncertain conditions. The research adopts a Fuzzy Logic-based Smart Home Energy Management System (FLSHEMS), combining energy optimization methods with conventional FLC models. This integration enables the system to learn its energy management tactics based on experience and feedback from environmental conditions, like occupancy and energy usage patterns. The performance of the system is tested in different scenarios, like peak demand, energy storage, and real-time energy optimization, and measures like energy savings, cost-effectiveness, and user comfort are gauged. Results indicate dramatic improvements in energy efficiency, with energy savings rates holding above 70 percent even under dynamic energy loads. The system is especially robust in realtime adaptability, successfully adapting energy consumption during peak hours while keeping comfort and costs to a minimum. The implementation effectively balances computational efficiency with control quality, rendering it appropriate for real-world use. This work makes a contribution to smart home energy management by presenting an adaptive and flexible control framework, providing real-world solutions for energy optimization, and proving the efficacy of integrating fuzzy logic with contemporary optimization methods for enhanced smart home performance.

articleTitle: API-GEN: Accelerator Tool for Generation of REST APIs
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on IT Innovation and Knowledge Discovery (ITIKD)
abstract: Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) are crucial for enabling seamless communication between software systems, allowing them to exchange data and perform tasks efficiently. They underpin essential operations across industries like e-Commerce, social media, and financial services. However, the traditional approach to API development is often labor-intensive, time-consuming, and prone to errors, diverting developers’ focus from innovation to repetitive coding tasks. This paper explores the concept and functionality of APIs, with a focus on automated API generation using JSON and class-based models. By automating this process, developers can streamline access to data from databases, significantly reducing manual effort while improving efficiency and accuracy. The study compares existing methods of API development with automated approaches, highlighting how automation can save time, minimize costs, and enhance the overall software development lifecycle. With its ability to simplify data integration and accelerate development, automated API generation represents a transformative solution for addressing the challenges of modern software systems, making the process faster, error-free, and more efficient.

articleTitle: Harnessing Renewable Energy Technologies in Biomedical Healthcare: Political Strategies for a Sustainable Future
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on IT Innovation and Knowledge Discovery (ITIKD)
abstract: The paper examines the potential for renewable energy technologies to achieve the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), especially in enhancing clean energy access, decreasing the emission of greenhouse gases and carbon footprints, promoting green hospital design, and enhancing economic and environmental growth. Renewable energy plays a vital role in advancing sustainability through addressing environmental, economic, and social challenges. It highlights the disconnect between healthcare organizations’ “business-as-usual” approach and the role of private interests in renewable energy adoption, leading to increased costs, patient suffering, and loss of GDP. The paper outlines various renewable technologies implemented in biomedical healthcare, emphasizing their ability to reduce energy costs, enhance sustainability, and improve patient outcomes. It also discusses the political strategies needed to promote renewable energy adoption, including effective regulatory frameworks and stakeholder engagement. The case studies presented provide insights for healthcare decision-makers, underscoring the importance of management-level support and staff education in enabling successful renewable energy programs. However, the paper identifies policy issues and the disparity between healthcare and energy policy imperatives as significant barriers to the widespread adoption of these technologies. The transformation to renewable energy sources as solar, wind, and biomass not only mitigates climate change, but it also enhances energy independence and creates green job opportunities, especially in rural areas. The paper concludes by emphasizing the need for healthcare organizations to prioritize sustainability and work towards integrating renewable energy solutions to address the intertwined challenges of energy and public health.as AI continues to transform occupational therapy practice.

Author Keywords: Renewable Energy – Sustainability- Biomedical Healthcare – SDGs- Green hospitals- Carbon footprints- Political Strategies

articleTitle: The Role of Artificial Intelligence in Writing Assessment: Learner Perceptions and System Effectiveness
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on IT Innovation and Knowledge Discovery (ITIKD)
abstract: Writing assessments play a crucial role in educational development, helping learners improve language skills and achieve academic success. Traditional assessment methods, often reliant on human evaluators, can lack consistency, require extensive time, and are limited in scalability. While Artificial intelligence (AI) driven writing tools like Grammarly and Turnitin have addressed aspects of grammar and plagiarism detection, they lack comprehensive feedback that supports holistic writing improvement. This research integrates AI-driven assessment into learner perception analysis to deliver an extensive writing improvement evaluation across various dimensions beyond simple grammar and plagiarism detection considered by previous studies. The study collects data from learners of varying educational levels to assess the tool's perceived effectiveness, clarity of feedback, and its impact on grammar improvement. Findings indicate that regular usage of AI writing tool significantly enhances writing skills, particularly in grammar and feedback clarity. Satisfaction ratings were high, with over 75% of participants reporting favorable perceptions of its accuracy, effectiveness, and fairness. This work demonstrates AI tools potential as a supportive educational tool, offering scalability and consistency in writing assessment, ultimately fostering student engagement and self-directed learning in writing.

articleTitle: The Role of AI in Early Disease Prediction and Medical Outcomes
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on IT Innovation and Knowledge Discovery (ITIKD)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is revolutionizing the healthcare industry, offering new possibilities for early disease prediction, personalized treatment, and enhanced decisionmaking. This paper provides an overview of the applications of AI in healthcare, exploring its potential to streamline operations, improve patient outcomes, and contribute to human welfare. The paper delves into the various types of AI systems, from narrow AI designed for specific tasks to general AI aimed at mimicking human intelligence. It highlights how AI tools, particularly when coupled with deep learning, can extract valuable insights from large healthcare datasets, enabling early prediction of diseases like cancer and chronic conditions. The paper also examines the role of AI in guiding clinical decisionmaking, leveraging predictive modeling to inform successive treatment decisions. Additionally, it explores the ethical considerations surrounding the use of AI in healthcare, including data privacy, bias, and the need to maintain the human touch in patient care. Finally, the paper looks toward the future, discussing recent AI-powered projects and research trends focused on understanding human bodily functions and enabling early disease detection. The potential economic rewards of robust AI implementation in healthcare are also addressed, underscoring the significant impact AI is poised to have on the industry.

articleTitle: Enhancing Emergency Blood Supply Chain Management Through a Demand-Driven Mobile Application for Rapid Donor Mobilization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on IT Innovation and Knowledge Discovery (ITIKD)
abstract: The expectation of blood availability during periods of critical need highlights the significance in maintaining an efficient and responsive blood supply chain, primarily dependent on voluntary donors. They are the workhorses of the system, providing a steady supply to keep blood stocks at optimum levels. Yet in emergencies when blood banks run short, such donors are the last line of defense. In this case, there is a critical factor over time. To do this, blood banks need to be able to quickly find and reach the nearest donor in order for hospitals to receive necessary life-saving supplies of blood. Blood donation is a selfless act that helps save lives, underpinning numerous medical treatments and emergency programs. That could cause a death for healthcare providers in emergencies or others who rely on the blood supply. It endorses the importance of a demand-driven system through which blood donors can be mobilized in haste. A smartphone application has been developed to supply this important need. This means that in times of emergency where the need is for blood immediately and not available at existing back bank shortcuts, it will search the nearest Blood Donor Volunteers from Permission enabled device aids owner to directly communicate by Call/SMS with respective Volunteer. In this paper, we present the application and its impact on enhancing emergency response time to save lives.

articleTitle: Oil Volatility Forecasting and Risk Management: A Hybrid Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on IT Innovation and Knowledge Discovery (ITIKD)
abstract: Volatility forecasting is an essential task for investors, speculators, and market practitioners. In finance, volatility is used in pricing options and financial derivatives, portfolio optimization, and risk management. Among the financial assets and commodities, crude oil ranks high in terms of economic development and investment purposes. However, the crude oil market is very complicated and fluctuates rapidly as many variables can influence the price of crude oil in different ways, such as global demand and supply, geopolitical risk factors, macroeconomic indicators, and the prices of other commodities such as gold and silver. The impact of such variables on crude oil prices could be indirect and non-linear. However, the literature until recently models crude oil volatility using statistical and econometric models which may not provide accurate forecasts due to the complexity of the market. In this research, to forecast crude oil volatility, the data of West Texas Intermediate (WTI) was collected over the period 2000 to 2023 from the Energy Information Administration (EIA) database, and an ensemble machine learning GJR-GARCH-SVR-LSTM model that is capable of recognizing patterns and complicated relationships between the variables was used. The findings of this research indicates that the used ensemble model provides better prediction accuracy than the existing models. Also, unlike the existing literature, another contribution of this study is that the proposed machine learning models were evaluated based on their hedging effectiveness by using the optimal hedge ratio, providing new hedging strategies to investors, crude oil producers, and other market participants.

articleTitle: Digital Twin-Based Smart Building Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on IT Innovation and Knowledge Discovery (ITIKD)
abstract: Transforming smart building management into a digital twin technology is operational efficiency and safety enhancement. This paper presents a digital smart building management system comprising an Arduino UNO and a Raspberry Pi 3 Model B designed to successfully achieve communication between sensors and device-related activities. Focused features include gas detection alerts, theft detection based on vibration, air quality monitoring (MQ135), occupancy detection (IR sensors), adaptive lighting control (LDR), and temperature/humidity control via DHT11. Early hazard detection is ensured from fire sensors. Real-time data processing with ThingSpeak integrated it contributed to continuous real-time monitoring. Emergency response would thus use a GSM module. The L293D driver controlled ventilation with both a CPU fan and DC motor. Feedbacks are relayed via real time on an LCD display too. This is a truly reliable, efficient, and safe building management system made possible through integrating digital twin technology with an IoT-based automation mechanism.

articleTitle: AI-Enhanced Cross-Modal Anime Recommendation System with Explainable Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on IT Innovation and Knowledge Discovery (ITIKD)
abstract: This paper presents an innovative approach to anime recommendation systems by integrating multi-modal deep learning with explainable AI techniques. We propose a novel framework that combines visual features, textual content, and user interaction data to create more accurate and interpretable recommendations. Our system addresses key challenges in ex-isting recommendation systems, including the cold-start problem and limited content understanding, through a hybrid architecture that leverages BERT-based natural language processing and convolutional neural networks for visual analysis. Experimental results demonstrate a 27% improvement in recommendation accuracy compared to traditional methods, while providing transparent explanations for recommendations through attention visualization.

articleTitle: Machine Learning for Asthma Prediction: Analyzing Health Data for Early Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on IT Innovation and Knowledge Discovery (ITIKD)
abstract: Asthma is a persistent respiratory condition that significantly affects people worldwide, making the prediction of asthma flare-ups crucial for enhancing patient care and optimizing healthcare resources. Despite progress in the field of machine learning, current predictive models often face challenges due to their dependence on historical clinical data alone. This paper evaluates existing asthma prediction models and introduces a new approach utilizing Bernoulli distribution and logistic regression to enhance prediction accuracy. Current models fre- quently depend on clinical variables such as coexisting conditions, past exacerbations, and healthcare engagement. Widely used, methodologies include decision trees, random forests, and logistic regression; however, these models generally perform poorly when evaluated on varied real-world datasets. A notable drawback is their inability to factor in environmental influences, such as air quality, weather patterns, and pollen counts, all of which play a role in asthma exacerbations. In future research, we will further investigate and refine techniques to better integrate a variety of data sources, aiming to make asthma prediction models more robust, dependable, and suitable for diverse populations.

articleTitle: Regulating AI in Occupational Therapy: Governance, Laws, and Policy Implications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on IT Innovation and Knowledge Discovery (ITIKD)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) has the potential to significantly enhance occupational therapy by enabling more nuanced observation, learning, and support for patient's participation and engagement. However, the widespread adoption of AI technologies in this domain raises critical ethical and regulatory concerns that must be addressed. This paper explores the key issues surrounding the use of AI in occupational therapy, including the need for robust regulation, the ethical principles that should guide AI development and deployment, and the current gaps in the regulatory landscape. It highlights the importance of prioritizing the systematic exploration of the regulatory and compliance environment to establish clear regulatory boundaries for the acceptable use of AI in occupational therapy. This research proposes a regulatory framework that aims to ensure the safe and ethical use of AI, address data governance and privacy concerns, and mandate practitioner training and education in AI literacy and ethics. Ultimately, the authors emphasize the need for proactive, forward-thinking policies and innovative research as AI continues to transform occupational therapy practice.

Author Keywords: AI – Occupational Therapy – Governance – Policy Implications-Mental rehabilitation- Disabilities

articleTitle: AI-Driven Nutritional Intelligence: A Predictive Data Analytics Framework for Personalized Dietary Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on IT Innovation and Knowledge Discovery (ITIKD)
abstract: Public health is critically dependent on nutrition, yet malnutrition and poor dietary habits persist globally. This study presents an AI-driven nutritional intelligence framework that leverages machine learning, behavioral insights, and real-time data analytics to enhance nutritional well-being. By integrating heterogeneous datasets-including dietary surveys, medical records, socioeconomic profiles, a nd g eospatial data-the proposed model identifies key nutritional deficiencies and risk factors for diet-related diseases. Predictive modeling is employed to generate personalized dietary recommendations, while wearable and mobile technologies facilitate real-time nutrient monitoring. Additionally, AI-powered learning platforms and community-driven interventions improve adherence to healthier eating habits. The study evaluates the framework through case studies and pilot programs, demonstrating measurable improvements in dietary outcomes and reduced nutritional disparities.

articleTitle: Improving Fire Type Classification in Bahrain Using Supervised Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on IT Innovation and Knowledge Discovery (ITIKD)
abstract: Fire breakouts are inevitable and can lead to the destruction of buildings, infrastructures, urban areas, and often result in severe medical complications for affected inhabitants. Bahrain is particularly prone to such incidents, due to the high population density, proximity to the equator, and naturally dry climate. The usage of Machine Learning (ML) for fire identification significantly increased the speed of classification while achieving increased reliability and accuracy. This study evaluates and compares the performance of three ML algorithms: Decision Trees (DT), Random Forests (RF), and Gradient Boosting Classifier (GBC), applied to analyze a dataset focused on fire type classification within the Kingdom of Bahrain. This study offers a novel approach for fire type classification, specifically tailored to the geographical conditions of Bahrain. The RF model achieved the highest performance, with accuracy (92.72%), recall (90.95%), precision (92.71%), F1 Score (91.74) and ROC-AUC (98.03%). This research establishes a foundation for utilizing advanced algorithms in fire analysis for Bahrain and demonstrates the effectiveness of RF in classifying the fire's type in similar contexts.

articleTitle: Digital Rupee Acceptance Dynamics Through the Lens of Theory of Planned Behaviour
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on IT Innovation and Knowledge Discovery (ITIKD)
abstract: This study aimed to examine the acceptance of the digital rupee by assessing the relationship between users’ attitudes, subjective norms, and perceived behavioral control. The theory of planned behavior is used to analyze the influence of users’ intention to accept digital rupees for financial transactions, emphasizing motivations and barriers affecting users’ intention to use digital rupees. Following the stratified random sampling technique, the responses were collected through a structured questionnaire to represent diverse users. Statistical tools, including regression analysis, ANOVA, and t-test, were applied to achieve the research objectives. The study explored the impact of demographic variables in relation to behavior and identified that occupation significantly affects behavior among users. The findings reveal that positive attitudes, subjective norms, and perceived behavioral control significantly influence the acceptance of digital rupees. The research outcomes contribute to the theoretical frameworks of user behavior towards digital currencies, as well as practical insights into the adoption of digital rupees.

articleTitle: Monitoring Incident Response Using Real-Time Analytics
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on IT Innovation and Knowledge Discovery (ITIKD)
abstract: In today's digital landscape, rapid and effective incident response is crucial for maintaining organizational security against sophisticated cyber threats. This project explores the optimization of incident response processes through the implementation of advanced data analytics, machine learning, and time series forecasting algorithms. The system utilizes historical incident data along with advanced algorithms like ARIMA, Support vector machine, LSTM, KNN, Facebook Prophet, Decision Tree, and Random Forest to predict incident volumes, prioritize tickets, and evaluate RFC outcomes. By combining these diverse predictive models, the system improves forecasting accuracy and reliability, offering valuable insights that aid strategic decision-making in incident management. The findings highlight the significant role that advanced analytics and machine learning play in streamlining incident response, improving operational efficiency, and ultimately contributing to a more robust cybersecurity posture for organizations. This research offers valuable recommendations for leveraging these technologies to enhance the effectiveness of incident response strategies.

articleTitle: Real-Time Sentiment Analysis of Customer Feedback Using Neural Networks and NLP Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on IT Innovation and Knowledge Discovery (ITIKD)
abstract: Realistic sentiment analysis will be in need of understanding customer feedbacks system's, facilitating data-depending decision making and improving user experience. This research model utilizing neural based networks and natural language processing systems (NLP) mechanism to realize faster and accurate level of customer sentiment computation on textual data. The proposed strategy investigates state-of-the-art neural network infrastructure to learn useful data-patterns and sentiments from the raw data. On other hand NLP performs factitive in pre-processing, feature extraction and textual-context awareness in interpretation of text. By enabling realistic processing of customer feedbacks, the system gives immediate visibility into customers' preference with their complaints and satisfaction grade. It also show that supervisor learning models in conjunction with NLP will effectively handles the heterogeneity as well as complexity in customer feedbacks. Finally, the proposed system demonstrate the way of real-time sentiment analysis ability can improve customer engagement leading to data-depend business mechanism.

articleTitle: Ethical and Legal Perspectives on Digital Telehealth in Genetic Counseling: Navigating Challenges and Opportunities
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on IT Innovation and Knowledge Discovery (ITIKD)
abstract: Expanding access to genetic services is a pressing challenge, amplified by the COVID-19 pandemic. Digital telehealth has emerged as a promising solution, enabling remote delivery of genetic counseling. However, significant barriers remain, including disparities in access due to structural, cultural, and societal factors. This paper explores key policy, ethical, and legal considerations related to the use of digital telehealth in genetic counseling. The authors highlight the potential of telehealth to address workforce shortages and increase patient access, while also noting the importance of preserving the genetic counselor-client relationship and ensuring privacy and security of sensitive genetic information. Policy frameworks and regulations are examined, emphasizing the need for adherence to professional standards and ethical guidelines. Ethical implications, such as the impact on access, informed consent, and quality of care, are also discussed. Looking to the future, the paper underscores the paramount need for comprehensive telehealth policies to support the efficient and effective integration of digital technologies in genetic counseling service delivery. Ultimately, this multifaceted analysis provides valuable insights for policymakers, advocates, and practitioners navigating the evolving landscape of genebased medicine and telehealth.

Author Keywords: Digital Telehealth – Genetic Counseling – Ethical and legal Perspectives

articleTitle: A Smart Framework for Optimizing User Feedback Prioritization in Application Development
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on IT Innovation and Knowledge Discovery (ITIKD)
abstract: In mobile app development, user reviews are a significant source of requirements. Users frequently report bugs, request new features, or suggest enhancements. Mobile app vendors aim to maximize user satisfaction by addressing these continuous comments and requests as early as possible. Typically, they prioritize delivering the most promising features, extracted from user reviews, in early releases while deferring fewer promising ones to later stages. However, due to the massive volume of reviews, redundancy, and conflicts among them, manually extracting requirements is inefficient and often challenging, making requirement prioritization even more difficult. Therefore, automating this process is essential. This paper presents a conceptual framework for the requirements prioritization process's automation, continuity, and scalability. The proposed framework follows a hybrid approach that integrates multiple advanced techniques: generative artificial intelligence, active learning, ontologies, and optimization algorithms. Generative artificial intelligence enables the identification of important patterns and the automatic extraction of requirements and their properties, which aids in assessing properties to determine requirement priorities. The generative artificial intelligence framework integrates with an active learning system to improve annotation efficiency. Ontologies help comprehend relationships, properties, and dependencies among requirements, aligning them with domain-specific knowledge. Optimization methods playa crucial role in the requirements prioritization process by computing the weights of various properties to identify the most effective combination of requirements and determine the optimal order for implementation. Consequently, this research presents a smart theoretical framework for enhancing user-driven maintenance and development of mobile applications. Researchers are tackling several critical challenges that remain unresolved in the field, with future directions focusing on evaluating its applicability and effectiveness in real-world scenarios.

articleTitle: Integrating Modern Portfolio Theory into Information Security Control Selection Optimisation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on IT Innovation and Knowledge Discovery (ITIKD)
abstract: Risk management and optimised security control selection in information technology, particularly information security, is crucial for identifying and mitigating organisational threats. Information security control selection and planning are challenging due to limited resources such as funding, time and staffing. This research article is an academic exposition in which a quantitative method of evaluating cyber security risk and utilizing principles of Modern Portfolio Theory (MPT) to optimize the allocation of resources and funding to select security controls to mitigate an organization's specific security risk and in addition reduce and organisations attack surface as the identified Return on Investment (ROI). This article details and illustrates a novel model that uses quantitative risk evaluation methods such as Monte Carlo simulations as opposed to the widely used qualitative methods in the aim to provide organisations with empirical data to make informed decisions, using Modern Portfolio Theory (MPT), when selecting and managing a portfolio of security controls such as Anti-DDOS solutions, Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) and Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB) solutions.

articleTitle: AI-Infused Smart Application Tracking System for Data-Driven Recruitment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on IT Innovation and Knowledge Discovery (ITIKD)
abstract: AI, ML, and NLP are used by the sophisticated Smart ATS to improve the hiring process. With features like AI-driven resume screening, predictive analytics for candidate sourcing, interview scheduling automation, and real-time candidate engagement through chatbots, it differs from traditional applicant tracking systems (ATS), which are primarily used as the foundational automation tool. They provide data-driven insights into optimizing recruitment strategies, reduce bias, and enhance the candidate experience. In order to learn from historical hiring data, the Smart ATS incorporates the use of other HR resources. Because they only offer AI-driven resume screening, predictive analytics for candidate sourcing, automated interview scheduling, and even real-time candidate engagement through chatbots, traditional applicant tracking systems are typically more foundational automation platforms than AI-powered ones. The applicant tracking system (ATS) accurately matches candidates with jobs by analyzing resumes, job descriptions, and communication through Natural Language Processing. This ensures a successful hiring process overall. In addition to saving hiring time and improving the caliber of chosen applicants, it offers practical insights regarding a candidate's fit for particular job requirements.

Author Keywords: Estimate Method and decent work for all

articleTitle: Drones in Innovative Education: A Systematic Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on IT Innovation and Knowledge Discovery (ITIKD)
abstract: Drone technology is an essential factor in today's education. This study examines the effect of drones on education. Leveraging observation and perception via systematic literature review, the research studies the types of drones used in education in several countries. The literature showed that drones have a significant impact on students. This emphasizes the need to lay out the different types of drones applicable to education. After conducting the systematic literature review, the study found that using drones in education in the GCC countries is not applied as yet. Knowing the significant effect of drones on education will allow policymakers in the GCC countries to adopt drones in the educational system. In the future, the GCC drone education adaptation framework will be conducted.

articleTitle: Text Sentiment Analysis from University Stakeholders feedback: A Comparative Analysis of RNN architectures and Transformer based model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on IT Innovation and Knowledge Discovery (ITIKD)
abstract: In this study, we use various RNN architectures namely, RNN, Bi-LSTM, and GRU — alongside BERT to analyze sentiment across university departments. Our aim is a comparative analysis of these models in sentiment classification within education. We collected and pre-processed textual data from multiple departments for balanced training and validation. Results showed that traditional RNNs achieved 90% accuracy, Bi-LSTM 93%, and GRU 89%. BERT, leveraging its Transformer architecture, outperformed with 94% accuracy. These findings highlight the superiority of BERT in capturing complex language patterns for sentiment analysis. This study underscores the potential of advanced neural network architectures to gain insights into departmental sentiments, informing policy decisions and educational strategies. Aligning with sustainable development goals in education, we aim to use AI models to develop effective, inclusive, and responsive educational strategies, enhancing quality and accessibility.

articleTitle: EMDAD: Bridging Farmers and Investors for Sustainable Agricultural Growth
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on IT Innovation and Knowledge Discovery (ITIKD)
abstract: Farmers in Saudi Arabia face significant challenges in accessing financing, which is critical for improving agricultural productivity and sustainability. To address this issue, we propose the EMDAD Investment Portfolio, an innovative digital platform that connects farmers with investors. EMDAD enables individuals to invest in specific agricultural projects before each growing season, providing farmers with the essential funds needed to operate their farms. Through the system, investors can explore diverse agricultural opportunities, access detailed project information, and select investments aligned with their financial goals. The platform also features an intuitive interface for tracking investments, monitoring project progress, and receiving updates on returns. By empowering farmers with financial resources and offering investors a unique opportunity to diversify into the agricultural sector. The limitations that must be addressed for approval to integrate with the Fanatic system and ensure successful deployment in future environments focus on security enhancements.

articleTitle: End-to-End Secure Cryptographic System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on IT Innovation and Knowledge Discovery (ITIKD)
abstract: Phishing is a pervasive and increasingly sophisticated cyberattack used by malicious actors to deceive individuals and steal sensitive information, such as passwords, credit card details, and personal data. These attacks often result in severe consequences, including identity theft, financial fraud, and unauthorized access to confidential systems. Despite the implementation of various security measures, phishing continues to pose a significant threat due to its adaptive nature. In response to this growing concern, we propose a novel solution to combat phishing attacks, titled the “Novel Antiphishing Framework Based on Visual Cryptography”. This innovative framework introduces a secure image-based authentication system that leverages the principles of Visual Cryptography (VC) to enhance security and privacy. The approach involves splitting an image CAPTCHA into two distinct, meaningless components, or “shares,” which are stored across different, independent database servers. Individually, these shares offer no information about the original CAPTCHA and appear as random patterns. However, when the shares are appropriately combined during the authentication process, the original CAPTCHA is reconstructed and revealed to the user. The reconstructed image then acts as a dynamic password, significantly enhancing the security of the authentication process. Even in the event of one share being intercepted or compromised, it remains entirely useless without the corresponding share, ensuring an added layer of security. By utilizing VC and a unique form of image-based authentication, this framework provides a robust defense mechanism against phishing attempts, making it extremely difficult for attackers to replicate or intercept authentication credentials. The proposed solution offers a novel and highly effective method for safeguarding user credentials, thereby addressing one of the most persistent challenges in cybersecurity.

articleTitle: Exploring Curricular Synergy Between ACM CS2023 Knowledge Areas and the UN Sustainable Development Goals

abstract: The United Nations' Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) call for global action to address interconnected challenges such as poverty, inequality, climate change, economic growth, and access to quality education and healthcare systems. As computing disciplines and technologies increasingly underpin critical sectors of sustainable development and play a vital role in solving complex problems, integrating the SDGs into computing education has become imperative. This paper briefly summarize the key points of a keynote speech presented at the International Conference on IT Innovation and Knowledge Discovery (ITIKD 2025). It explores the conceptual and curricular synergy between the ACM Computer Science 2023 (CS2023) Knowledge Areas and the SDGs. By aligning SDGs with CS2023 domains, the paper provides insights for a structured perspective to incorporate sustainability into undergraduate computing curricula. This proposed alignment aims to serve as a foundation to guide educators, curriculum designers, and institutions in rethinking computing education to equip future professionals and leaders with both technical expertise and sustainability awareness and competencies for systemic thinking, and interdisciplinary impact.

abstract: Digital technologies have the potential to transform service delivery and bring operational efficiency to organizations. Therefore, different sectors of economies such as governments [1], businesses [2], [3], and energy [4] are striving to integrate technologies into their organizational processes. Digital transformation in every domain has improved efficiency and productivity. However, the integration of digital technologies in modern day human life has led to challenges and failures. The challenges like digital divide, cybersecurity risks, ethical concerns on information transparency and human job replacement require considerable efforts and collaboration from all stakeholders. Global digital index [5], has adopted a market demand and supply driven approach of technology adoption. They have categorized different economies into front runners, adopters and starters based on four enablers. The data highlights that still significant effort is required to foster appropriate digital transformation initiatives in the global context. According to International Data Corporation, global digital transformation initiatives are expected to be around $4 trillion by 2027 [6], and only one third of these projects end up in meeting the objectives successfully [7].
